findings.title: P2: Qualify the unsupported retrieval-to-round connection
findings.body: At b2b85d4c8d3174aa41507cde77637227bb709e1e, corpus search returns items and a coverage gap to its caller (skills/prism/server/control-server.ts:861–886). Round creation instead snapshots the active request and preferences (skills/prism/control/design-generations.ts:32–40); the generation prompt consumes those inputs without retrieving corpus results (skills/prism/server/agent-prompt.mjs:5–20). These sources establish retrieval availability, but not the depicted retrieval-to-round handoff. Even as a relationship diagram, this edge claims an implemented dependency without identifying a consumer. Remove it or explicitly mark it as an optional integration requiring separate source proof. The adjacent statement that retrieval 'can supply' material does not establish that linkage.

findings.title: P2: Distinguish optional corpus artifact references from implemented storage
findings.body: The artifact-store-to-corpus arrow suggests the implemented corpus depends on retained CAS objects. At the pinned revision, ingestion verifies acquisition bytes, stores normalized metadata and source_content_digest, then deletes the quarantine acquisition (skills/prism/server/control-server.ts:822–841). The corpus INSERT does not populate source_artifact_id or analysis_artifact_id (skills/prism/corpus/index.ts:111–131). Those columns merely exist as nullable schema fields (skills/prism/storage/migrations/001_prism.sql:44–50). Unlike architecture requests and baseline bundles, this path does not write corpus bytes to the content-addressed artifact store. Remove the edge or label it explicitly as an optional schema reference that current ingestion leaves unset.

overall_explanation:
ONE diagram diagram-e8beb8435cf1a6fc: NOT_READY. Read-only inspection used actual Git objects at b2b85d4c8d3174aa41507cde77637227bb709e1e. Below, paths are relative to skills/prism/. These are relationship/dependency edges, not a chronological state machine; adjacent prose explicitly separates approval from publication.

Per-edge Source proof:
1. Project→Request: storage/migrations/006_design_request.sql:3–10, project ownership FK.
2. Request→Round: storage/migrations/013_design_round.sql:1–4,19, request ownership and nullable current-round pointer.
3. Round→Three directions: storage/index.ts:151–175, validated three-item result, round binding and transactional persistence; not guaranteed for unfinished/failed rounds.
4. Direction→Document: storage/index.ts:164–172, direction references its created document; relational direction, not creation order.
5. Document→Revision: storage/migrations/001_prism.sql:15–22 and storage/index.ts:270–290, inserted revision plus guarded current pointer.
6. Revision→Approval: server/control-server.ts:539–563, current revision bound to approval after quality/warning and active-request checks; optional decision.
7. Approval→Baseline: server/control-server.ts:598–629,778–790, matching revision/digest/architecture, quality, accepted warnings and selected direction required; approval alone does not publish.
8. Baseline→Bundle: server/control-server.ts:775–790, record references stored bundle ID and digest.
9. Preference events→Snapshot: control/preference-snapshot.ts:15–28, policy-filtered eligible events and effective profile, possibly empty.
10. Snapshot→Round: control/design-generations.ts:36–40 and storage/migrations/013_design_round.sql:1–4, same generation/round identity, created transactionally.
11. Corpus→Retrieval: corpus/index.ts:170–184, active current revisions filtered by design-use rights and expiry; results may be empty.
12. Retrieval→Round: unsupported implemented linkage; first finding.
13. Document→Renderer: server/control-server.ts:693–712, approved document passed for each view/state/viewport with capture enabled.
14. Renderer→Bundle: server/control-server.ts:713–729,747–758, capture/ARIA output included in archive only after evidence and accessibility checks; failures abort publication.
15. Artifact store→Request: server/control-server.ts:305–320, stored architecture ID/digest referenced by request; storage dependency, not ownership of request rows.
16. Artifact store→Corpus: optional schema fields only; contradicted as current ingestion/storage dependency, second finding.
17. Artifact store→Bundle: server/control-server.ts:753–776 and storage/artifacts.ts:43–58, assembled archive persisted under content-derived identity.

No tests, generators, product execution, nested review, SVG-hash inference or browser acceptance used. No global acceptance established; PUB005/A91206 remain NOT_READY pending all 27 diagrams.
